action.rationale: Fresh 30D problem with budget 100 and no incumbent; probing (~12% of budget) will characterize the landscape and seed the archive before committing to a method.

Dim=30 with only 88 evals left; probes show a partial funnel (fdc_spearman=0.6713) but top-10 are widely spread (top10_spread_vs_uniform=0.9167), so method choice is ambiguous. A small race between TuRBO and CMA-ES will quickly identify the better global optimizer for this landscape while preserving budget. Current best is 1352.04 vs median 1545.8, indicating ample room for improvement.

TuRBO won the race decisively (1214.34 vs 1221.66 over 15 evals) and is active with tr_length=0.8 in init phase; it hasn’t had a chance to run post-race yet. With 58 evals left and probes indicating multiple basins (top10_spread_vs_uniform=0.9167), continuing TuRBO is the best next step before any polishing. Given the recent progress, I expect a modest improvement over 1214.34 this round.
